laat_vaar.voor: te beplan om die regering onder druk te plaas
laat_vaar.na: te beplan wat die regering onder druk moes plaas
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Two stacked 'om ... te' clauses in one sentence read heavily; a relative clause on 'sabotasie' keeps the purpose and flows better.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original purpose clause correctly ties the aim to Mandela's act of planning; the proposal makes the sabotage itself the agent, adds the modal 'moes' (had to / was meant to), and leaves the relative clause separated from 'sabotasie' by 'te beplan', so it is no clearer and shifts the meaning.

na_skrywer.voor: Wanneer mense wat teenoor mekaar gestaan het, vrede maak en saam vorentoe gaan.
na_skrywer.na: Om vrede te maak en saam vorentoe te gaan nadat mense teenoor mekaar gestaan het.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Defining a noun with 'Wanneer' copies the English 'is when'; the 'Om ... te' form matches the sabotasie entry and keeps the meaning.
na_skrywer.fout: The glossary entry defines the noun 'versoening' with a 'Wanneer ...' clause, which copies the English 'is when' pattern rather than naming what reconciliation is.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but this is a shared glossary definition reworded beyond spelling or grammar, so the writer must fix it for every lesson at once rather than a language agent here.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.rede: The block heading uses 'erfenis' as a bare predicate, which reads unnaturally; 'deel van ons erfenis' would be more idiomatic, but a heading may not be changeable by the script, so this is flagged for the reviewer or writer.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Van sy 27 jaar as politieke gevangene
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Van Mandela se 27 jaar as politieke gevangene
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The block opens under a new heading with a bare 'sy', so the referent is named once for a reader who starts here.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'sy' can only refer to Mandela, who is the subject of the block just before it, and the next block opens with a bare 'hy' too, so naming him here alone is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A bare '18' after 'mense van' reads incomplete; 'jaar' makes clear it is an age.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'mense van 18 en ouer' is ordinary, clear Afrikaans for an age in a voting sentence, so adding 'jaar' only reads differently.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: swaar werk doen soos klip breek
laat_vaar_vorige.na: swaar werk doen, soos klip breek
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A comma before the examples stops 'swaar werk doen soos klip breek' being read as 'work as hard as breaking stone' and marks the examples clearly.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The AWS 2017 does not require a comma before 'soos' introducing examples, the sentence reads clearly in context, and the lesson already writes 'dinge soos kragmaste' without one, so this is a lateral move that would make the lesson inconsistent.
